paper_title: Incorporating Domain Knowledge into Materials Tokenization
caption: Comparison of Micro-F1 scores for ChemDataExtractor and MatDetector across different values.
model_annotation: This line plot compares the Micro-F1 scores of two models, MatDetector and ChemDataExtractor, across various lambda values. The x-axis represents the lambda value, ranging from "w/o" to 3, with no units provided, and has a linear scale with tick labels at irregular intervals. The y-axis represents the Micro-F1 score as a percentage, ranging from 52% to 58%, with no units provided, and has a linear scale with tick labels at intervals of 1%. The plot features two lines: one for MatDetector, which is pink with circle markers and a solid line style, and one for ChemDataExtractor, which is dark blue with square markers and a dashed line style. The MatDetector line starts at approximately 53% at "w/o" and fluctuates, peaking at around 57.5% at lambda value 1, before declining to around 54% at lambda value 3. The ChemDataExtractor line starts at approximately 53% at "w/o", also fluctuating, and reaches a peak of around 55% at lambda value 0.7, before stabilizing around 54% at lambda value 3.
